summary: Wrote homily.tex with its two declared components: the spoken body (sections/homily/10-homily.tex), 1,453 words, about 11.2 to 12.1 minutes at 120 to 130 words a minute by arithmetic, with no timed delivery. It speaks to an adult parish assembly for 4 October 2026 and joins the first and third readings (the garment of charity and the new man; the feast that now is), taking the story of the call from the second. It uses the Gospel, Epistle, Gradual, Collect, Introit, Communion and Postcommunion, voices the Augustine/Hilary and baptism/charity disagreements, and keeps every bound in interpretations.md section 4.5. The terminal note and References are in sections/homily/90-note.tex. Also: the homily components' references in the manifest, a derive-homily contribution with timestamp 2026-09-30T20:57:05Z in the shared generation record, and the production audit entry. All 38 quotations were re-checked in tracked sources (Jerome on the re-fetched, digest-matched PL 26 page images). All three editions build clean (33, 12 and 3 pages; the concise aux is unchanged), and every homily-preflight check passes locally. The only upstream item reported is the standing research-owned STU-012.
